text:
nina: quick heads-up 1 1 PhaedraPharm opened an onboarding asking us to serve a domain-adapted 7B "pharma-summarizer" model in our Private offering. Requirements: customer-managed HSM, strict PHI/PII scrubbing, daily redacted trace CSVs, and a formal safety/regulatory eval before GA. They want a soft GA in ~3 weeks. I've attached their intake and a small sample set to the bucket.

omar: Got it. Do we know artifact format, expected throughput, and any latency goals? Also curious if they want streaming or non-streaming responses.

nina: Artifact is HF safetensors + tokenizer. They plan int8 post-train quant but are open to 4-bit if needed. QPS steady ~6, burst ~25. Latency target p50 <260ms for 600-token responses; p95 <520ms. They prefer non-streaming for the pipeline step, but may switch to streaming later.

kevin: Request: ask them to provide a 150-item "known-bad" case set and a 1k+ safety prompt suite covering adversarial PHI probes. Need to baseline vs redwood-7b-summary. Also confirm whether weights should live in customer S3 (BYO) or our object storage.

onboard-bot: Intake registered: PP-ONB-2026-901  assigned: cs-ops  priority: P2  ticket: CS-ONB-8233

nina: Uploaded: gs://redwood-cs/phaedra/phaedra_sample_v1.csv and intake doc link: https://phaedra.example/secure/intake. Model pointer they provided: s3://phaedra/models/phaedra-7b.safetensors.

omar: I'll set a cross-team sync w/eng + security tomorrow 2pm PT. @kevin can you own the eval harness? Also need privacy to validate the scrubbing spec and HSM attestation paperwork.

kevin: I'll take evals. Plan: run baseline + customer model on 5k prompts (mix of customer examples + adversarial set) and compute extractive F1 for key entities, hallucination delta, PHI leakage (recall), and latency percentiles. Running harness: 
```
python eval_tool.py --model s3://phaedra/models/phaedra-7b.safetensors \
                    --prompts gs://redwood-cs/phaedra/phaedra_sample_v1.csv \
                    --baseline redwood-7b-summary \
                    --metrics extractive_f1,hallucination,phi_leak,latency
```
Expect first-pass within 72 hours. If int8 causes >3% F1 loss well try 4-bit or dedicated instance options.

nina: Procurement noted a renewal risk: they will pilot alternatives if p50 >300ms at GA. Flagging this as sensitive for the renewal conversation.

omar: For infra: if customer wants VPC peering + BYO S3 + customer-managed HSM we need cross-account roles, peering docs, and key attestation forms. I'll draft the onboarding checklist and HSM key exchange steps.

kevin: Rollout suggestion: internal QA -> private canary (5%) -> extended canary (30%) -> full traffic over 10 days. Canary monitors: extractive F1, PHI recall, hallucination rate, and latency. Auto-rollback triggers: evidence F1 drop >2.5% or PHI leakage event.

nina: Customer also asked for daily redacted traces (CSV) and a weekly compliance summary. I'll confirm which fields are allowed in the CSV and how they want redaction performed (token-level vs entity-level).

omar: One more operational note: make sure KMS key rotation and attestation windows match their audit timeline. They require quarterly attestations. Adding security to tomorrow sync.

kevin: I'll start eval runs once I get the confirmed-bad set and the larger safety prompt pack. Ping me when those are uploaded.

nina: pinged the customer for the 150 known-bad cases and the PHI whitelist/blacklist. Scheduling the sync invites now. Will update this thread with meeting notes and the eval artifacts.
